utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good morning. The witness should be brought in, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: If I may, Mr. President, while the witness is being brought in.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Good morning to you and Your Honours. Good morning to the Defence. Good morning, everyone. I just wanted to let the Chamber know I followed up on Honourable Judge Mindua's inquiry yesterday regarding Ramo Osmanovic and his son and whether there would be any testimony before the Trial Chamber concerning him. What I found out was that, as I mentioned yesterday, we have a couple of witnesses who were at the Sandici Meadow who will be able to testify about the circumstances there. One of those witnesses, Witness 51, PW-14, I can tell the Trial Chamber, did identify Mr. Osmanovic in his testimony, in his prior testimony, his 92 bis testimony. He was witness PW-127 in Popovic. He didn't say much more than that, than just saying, I know that man, but that witness will be here, and he will be discussing these events. So I wanted to let Your Honours know that we do have somebody who will recognise Mr. Osmanovic from the video that we're watching now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Thayer. Good morning, Mr. President Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Welcome back. May I remind you that your affirmation to tell the truth still applies.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: And Mr. Thayer is continuing his examination-in-chief. Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: What I'd like to do is pick up where we left off and resume playing the video for just a moment to get us started. If we could resume playing at 10:18, if we could back up a few seconds. We're at 10:17.6.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, I think you testified yesterday about this black-out. And if we could go to 11:14 now. And we should be at pages 30 and 31 of the road book, which is P1251.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Sorry, may I ask for a hard copy of the map book.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: It should be handed over to the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: You spoke about the two brothers in Still A on page 30 and how you were able to identify a portion of the destroyed white house in the Still B behind Mr. Borovcanin's head. And I just want to pick up from where we are in the video. And if we could roll the video, please. We're at 11:13.6 in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, we've stopped at 11:48.2 in Sanction. And if we could turn to pages 32 and 33 in the hard book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Sir, you -- can you explain to the Trial Chamber what's going on with the actual camera? We just saw Mr. Borovcanin and those two soldiers interacting, and now we're focusing on the Sandici Meadow. Can you describe the action of the camera between these two shots that we just saw? What physically happens with the camera? What direction does it travel?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The cameraman who recorded this footage, he was standing on the site of the destroyed white house, and he recorded Mr. Borovcanin and these two soldiers. And suddenly he moved the camera across the road towards Sandici Meadow, and he -- we have the footage now from Sandici Meadow. We see the people in the meadow, soldiers standing up there, and part of the tank.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And you're referring to a part of a tank. Can you identify for the Trial Chamber in this image where that part of the tank is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If -- on the footage on the screen and on the image from my road book from the page 32, Image A, on the left side -- on the left side of this image we see the part of the tank. It's not visible very well, but when we play the video later on, we can see that this is a tank.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And you're describing or referring to a dark object immediately to the left of the group of soldiers who are standing around the seated prisoners?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, I am referring to this object.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And did your investigation disclose any testimony or statements concerning the presence of a tank at the Sandici Meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We -- in fact, we talked to a few people from Sekovici Detachment. They mentioned that Sekovici Detachment had two tanks in Bratunac and Konjevic on this road, in this area, but, in fact, none of them admitted that this tank belonged to the Sekovici Detachment. Nobody told us that this tank -- exactly this tank in Sandici Meadow is Sekovici Detachment tank.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So the Serb soldiers who belonged to these armoured units wouldn't admit to the tank being theirs. Did you interview or have you read any interviews or testimony of survivors or other people who were present -- Muslim prisoners who were present on the meadow who referred to a tank or stated that they saw a tank there?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I remember. I remember a statement, but I don't remember the name of the people who have been interviewed. But I remember the statement of one of the survivors, at least, who remembered the tank in Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And for the record --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I don't remember his name.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. For the record, Your Honours, you will be hearing from, again, PW-14, Witness 51, with respect to that issue, and I think there are other witnesses as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now -- and, again, the still here on e-court at 11:48.2, we can, I think, see the tip of the antenna of Mr. Borovcanin's car in the center; is that correct? Can you see that, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, let's keep playing. I just want you to describe what happens with the camera next.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 11:53.2.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We saw the image zoom in on the crowd of prisoners, surrounded by these soldiers. Can you tell the Trial Chamber, is that zooming something Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac did or is that something that the OTP did in creating this presentation?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, Mr. Pirocanac did the zooming.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if we look at page 33 of your road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber how it was that you determined the location, as you've indicated, of Video Stills A, B and C in this circle on your photograph?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe I told you it yesterday, that the feature of this area is very significant, for me, at least, which is the small house in the Still A from page 32, and the same small house is visible also in my picture, on our panorama picture, on page 33.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Right. Now, this photograph that we have here on page 33, is it a single photograph or is it a composite?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, this is a composite. We just recreated the panorama view of Sandici Meadow. It's containing few photographs, I believe two or three photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, physically, that was done by Mr. Lesic at the time in 2006?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, physically, it was done by him. He was operating the software which we used to create this panorama picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, just for the record, I note that on page 32 we have indicated the time of Still B as 11 minutes and 54 seconds. I think we all saw that this was an uninterrupted pan and shot, so that, I don't think there will be any dispute, there's a typo there. Instead of "54 seconds," it should be "44 seconds."

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Do you agree, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Judge Nyambe has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you. At page 4, line 7/8, you are noted, Mr. Thayer, having asked the following question: "And did your investigation disclose any testimony or statements concerning the presence of a tank at Sandici Meadow?" I was unable to pick up the tank in the screen that was shown. Could you please replay that? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Certainly, Your Honour. We can do two things. We can go back to this particular footage, and then we can focus in on another image, from a different angle, where you can see the tank --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: -- or another tank, at least. But let's try this again, and let's start at 11 minutes and, say, 40 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 11:47.9 in Sanction. I think this is about as good as we're going to get in this system in e-court, in terms of visibility.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, can you see what you previously described or identified as the tank?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's this black object on the left-hand side, next to the group of the people in the middle. This is a tank, I believe this is a tank. This picture maybe is not so clear, you know, the tank is not visible. But when we play in slow motion in another part of the video, we can see the part clearly, we can see the tank over there in this place. That is not here, that is not visible, but it's the same -- exactly in the same place.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: In the trial video that we have, we have done such a slow-motion breakdown, almost frame by frame, of this portion of the Petrovic video. Since we're trying to show just the Petrovic video, with the exception of a couple of other things -- we don't have that right now, but we can certainly go back to the trial video and isolate that slow-motion section, in which it will be a little bit more visible. So we'll need a couple of minutes to locate that time, but we can come back to that, certainly. Yes, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: If I may, I'd like to refer to page 28 of this book. On Still Frame A, you see this tank quite clear. It's in the same position we see on this -- on this image from page 32.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, Mr. Blaszczyk, in which direction, in this frame, is the tank pointed?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's pointed towards south.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So in this frame, is the tank pointed towards the men seated at the Sandici Meadow or is it pointed away from the men and across the road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's difficult to say. It could also be on the man sitting on the meadow, but also to the hills which are visible just across the road. We see the tank has a barrel and a machine-gun, I guess.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And I think you've testified already, with respect to the Video Still D, that you weren't able to precisely pin-point where, in the Sandici Meadow area, this taNk was located in this footage.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Indeed. In fact, I don't know whether it is the same tank visible on the Still Frame A or this is another one, because as I told, I know the statement of the Sekovici Detachment people, that they had two tanks. I don't know whether there was one or there was another nearby, but it's possible that is the same one.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, you were mentioning Video Still D. You mean on page 28?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn back to pages 32 and 33. And, in fact, we can move on to pages 34 and 35. And let's resume playing the video for a couple of moments so we can see the transition to the next portion. We're starting at 11:47.9.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 12:12.1 in Sanction. We could see that there was a little bit of a blacked-out portion there and then some footage of an ammunition crate.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber, do you know what was going on there on the tape, in that portion?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: You mean this black portion? It's visible [sic] that was over-recorded or just erased, the contents of this part of the video where we see the black one. And next we see the crate of ammunition, and we see also -- we notice APC -- Serbian APCs.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And we're coming up to that portion of the APCs. Do you know -- do you have any idea whether that footage of the ammunition crate was shot at the same time as the footage we're showing, or was that another example, like with the artillery shell, where the video was recorded over? And if you don't know, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe this is the part of the original raw material. It was recorded on the 13 of July, 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's play for about another 20 seconds. Again, we're at 12:12.1 now.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 12.35 in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber has seen some of this footage already of these Pragas and the BOVs firing their anti-aircraft cannons. Where are we now? What is this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I managed to spot this location. This is in the vicinity of the village of Pervani. The village is located about 3.000 -- 2.800 metres from Sandici Meadow towards Konjevic Polje, towards west from Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just in terms of the road book, we are looking at the approximations almost the same as Video Still B, just for the record. Is that correct, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, almost the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And is this footage still being shot by Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this footage is shot by Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And is he still with Mr. Borovcanin?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's still with Mr. Borovcanin. If we play later on, we can see even Mr. Borovcanin walking towards the Praga and BOV.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just to be clear, how did they get to this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: They used the car they had at that time, which Mr. Borovcanin was using, Pirocanac and a driver.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's pick up the video. Again, we're at 12:35.1, starting.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we've stopped at 13:38.9. And were you able to just see something happening with Mr. Borovcanin's car?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, we see a part of Mr. Borovcanin's car is standing behind the Praga and BOV.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And did you see the door open on the car in that footage or do you want to see it again?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you play it, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We're at 13:38.4.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yeah, now it's visible that that door is open.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And we have a time code here of 16:48.16 on the 13th of July. And you're familiar with this footage. Just to give us a little preview, who is getting out of the car at this point?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is -- from this side, this is the driver and Mr. Borovcanin. I know that, because later on he's visible on the road also --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- walking towards Praga and BOV.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, we started this footage at the point where Mr. Petrovic began filming these fighting vehicles firing the anti-aircraft guns at 12 minutes and 12 seconds, and we see here that Mr. Borovcanin and his driver get out of the car about a minute and a half later, after watching these cannons firing. Now, Ms. Gallagher, in her testimony, referred to the statement given by one of the Serb soldiers operating one of the anti-aircraft cannons here, that this firing into the woods was done at Mr. Borovcanin's instructions for the sake of the cameras. Now, based on your investigation, interviewing of witnesses who may have seen armoured vehicles, anti-aircraft weapons, on this road, firing, did you find this statement by this Serb gunner to be credible, that the firing only at these locations happened because Mr. Borovcanin wanted to do it for the cameras?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's not credible for me, I believe. Okay, maybe at this moment the fire was opened on the request of Mr. Borovcanin, but they used to drive along this road and they used to shoot into the hills the entire time.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: When you say "entire time," what are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I mean the entire time when they have been located in this area on the road between Sandici towards Konjevic Polje. And we have the statement of a lot of people who heard the fire, who were shoot by this fire, also people from the column.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, indeed, you've reviewed this footage numerous times. Did you find any evidence that Mr. Borovcanin provided or gave any instructions to these gunners in these vehicles before we see him getting out of his car here in this still, after having watched them fire for that minute and a half that we just watched?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, I don't. As I said, as I just stated, there was shooting here, and later on it's possible that when we see Mr. Borovcanin getting out of the car and walking towards them, asking. Probably, possible, we cannot exclude that he asked them to fire again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Judge Nyambe has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: You're talking about seeing Mr. -- somebody get out -- Borovcanin getting out of the car. I see only a car open. I don't see anybody getting out.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I'd asked Mr. Blaszczyk to give us a preview of what we're going to see, and we're going to roll the tape right now, as a matter of fact, so you can see the next stage in the footage. And we're at 13:38.4, so let's keep rolling the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We're at 14 minutes 23.8 seconds in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you identify who this individual is walking away from the camera towards the anti-aircraft vehicle?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe this is Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we heard some music playing in the background after that door was opened. Can you tell us what's going on with that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is music coming out from the car, from the Mr. Borovcanin car. It has been confirmed by Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's just look at your road book for a couple of moments here. I think we can all see, particularly in Video Stills B, C and D, that those were derived from the clip that we just saw. What is going on in Video Still A? Can you explain that to us? We see two different times on the left and the right. We have "14:08" on the left and "14:07" on the right. I should say "14:08.8" and then "14:07.18" [Realtime transcript read in error "14:07.8"] on the right on Still A on page 34, and we see the time codes stamped on the video still. And then there is a red dotted line down the middle of that video still. Can you just tell us what's going on with that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Because Mr. Pirocanac Petrovic used a camera with not -- without a wide lens, we just matched two footage images from this recording. They are next to each other. This is why, just to make it visible, we put this dotted line over here that's showing that this is not one footage image from the recording but two footage images matched together.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Just to be clear on the record, line 25 of page 13, you, Mr. Thayer, are recorded to have said: "I should say '14:08.8,' and "14:07.8' but the last "8" should be "18" if we look at the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes, you're correct, Mr. President, absolutely, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: You're recorded as saying "14:08.7" -- sorry, I repeat. You're recorded having said "14:08" and then "14:07.8," and it should read "14:07.18."

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Precisely.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Now we have it.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: With respect to this Still A, is another way of looking at it or explaining it that what we are looking at are two frames from the video that were close to each other that you've just put together, one that elapsed after the other one?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. I would like to create a better view or a wider view of this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And if we look at your photograph on page 35, how were you able to determine that this is where the action in Video Stills A through D took place?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: You see that looks a little bit different, but if you look -- if we look at the edge of the hills in front of us, we can see this is the same. And I was on this place, and we played this video, raw material, Petrovic material, and it could be the only place when it was recorded. If you look at the shape of the hills at the end of the picture, for example, 55, if you look at the end and the shape of the same hills of the Frame C from page 54 [sic], you can compare that is the same -- the same line of hills.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn the page and go to 36 and 37.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, you were referring to page 34, I think.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: 34, yes, that's correct, sir.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I think we can dispense with playing the footage for these two pages. I think the Trial Chamber saw some of this with Ms. Gallagher.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber how you were able to match up the video stills on page 36 with your photographs on page 37 of these various houses?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we would see the video, we see that the APCs, they are moving towards Konjevic Polje. Another 300 metres or 400 metres from the place where we seen the recordings before, there are a few houses on the left side on the road, and I located these houses, and I also managed to compare these houses from the Petrovic video to compare the features of these houses on that day when I took the photos of these houses, and they are the same houses which are visible on the Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we look at the houses in your 2006 photographs, 1 and 2, we can see that it appears that there's been some repair work in some places on these houses, so -- and they look different in 2006. How can you be confident that these are the same houses from the footage?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course they look different, but if you look at the shape of the houses and the order of these houses, how they're standing to each other, we see that they are the same. Okay, you have to take into consideration that, after the war, the houses were rebuilt somehow, but it's visible that they are still the same even after the reconstruction. Look at the shape of the windows, for example, the House A from the Frame A, and look at the picture I took or Zoran took in 2006.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, for the record, the Video Still D on page 36 is at 14 minutes 57 seconds of the video. And up to this point in the video, sir, we're here in Pervani, in which direction were Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin headed? In which direction were they driving?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Driving towards Konjevic Polje, towards west, and following -- they are following the two APCs until this point of this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And when you say they were following the two armoured vehicles, what do you mean?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: That we see on this picture that it was intention probably of Mr. Borovcanin and Pirocanac to record the activity of these two APCs. They are recording the shelling, the moving out.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And at what point did they, to use your words, begin following these APCs? At what point did that happen?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: When -- you mean --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let me put it this way: Were these APCs already located at Pervani when Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac arrived on the scene, or did the APCs and Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Pirocanac all travel together from some other location to Pervani?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's visible that when they arrived to Pervani, the APCs were located already there. The APCs were shooting towards the hills. And then when Mr. Borovcanin approached the -- approached the APCs, the APCs moved a few hundred metres towards Konjevic Polje and shooting again.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And is it at that point that you're referring to that Mr. Borovcanin follows those anti-aircraft vehicles?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I mean -- I mean, these few hundred metres, in fact, 300 metres or something like.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now let's go to pages 38 and 39, please. And let's resume playing the video. And we'll skip a little bit, but we'll pick up in a moment. Okay, we're at 14:28.8 in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We're just going to stop for a moment at 15 minutes 3.2 seconds on Sanction just so we have a time reference. I think the Chamber remembers seeing these weapons firing, so we're going to skip ahead and save about a minute or so. If we could skip to, let's say, 16 minutes. Thank you. We're now at 16 minutes. Let's resume playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now we're at 16:32.6 in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We can see that they are back in the car. We could hear, I think, the -- you could hear the engine accelerating. They seem to be moving a little bit faster. Can you tell the Trial Chamber, what's going on here in this portion of the footage?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is first recorded footage from Petrovic video that we see that Mr. Borovcanin, together with Pirocanac and his driver, they are returning towards Sandici Meadow. They are on the way now towards Sandici, Kravica, Bratunac. They made that U-turn and they're turning back to Sandici Meadow. This is first recorded footage by Mr. Borovcanin on the way back. In the background, we can hear also the conversation through the radio.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And just while we're here, do you recall -- yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Just for clarification: On the video footage, who is depicted as "NMG 2"?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it's a question to me. Yes, this is no man, just talking on the radio. But there is a mention of his nickname, the officer. We know this nickname, this is the nickname of a member of the special -- of the Sekovici Detachment of the Special Police Brigade. I think his real name is Rade Cuturic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE NYAMBE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So we have this Special Police Brigade officer whose nickname is Oficir; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And what is his command relationship, if you know, to Mr. Borovcanin?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Borovcanin is the duty head of the Special Police Brigade, and this Oficir, Rade Cuturic, is one of the commanders of the Sekovici Detachment who is a part of the Special Police Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's keep rolling the tape for just a couple of seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, just to pick up on Her Honour Judge Nyambe's question, if we look at the subtitling here, there's the initials "LJB," and he appears to be saying: "Oficir, B or." Can you explain that to the Trial Chamber, based on your numerous reviews of this video and listening to the audio, and other portions of your investigation, what's going on here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can see -- we can hear, in fact, here that Ljubomir Borovcanin responding to Oficir, to Cuturic, calling him on the radio, Oficir, Bor."

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And what is "Bor"?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Bor" is -- the people used to call Borovcanin "Bor." It's kind of a nickname of Mr. Borovcanin. And the officer is responding on the radio, I am listening, and Ljubisa Borovcanin ordering them to stop the traffic behind them, behind Oficir. I believe Oficir was at that time in Kravica.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And based on your investigation, what is happening at this time in Kravica?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Based on my investigation -- or our investigation, I believe that the execution, or events in Kravica started at about this time. The shooting started in Kravica warehouse, the people -- the killing began at that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And this series of events, Your Honours, will obviously be the subject of more testimony in the future and may, in fact, be the focus of some more directed, narrow testimony of Mr. Blaszczyk or another investigator about the specific timing of the events concerning the Kravica warehouse executions and this video. So we will come back to you with a narrower focused analysis of these events, incorporating other exhibits. We don't want to take up the time with the road book now, but I wanted to alert you and the Defence that we have something like that in mind to look at these events in closer detail.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you. But I would like to put a question to the witness related to this part of the footage and the pages 38 and 39 of the road book. We see the Picture A, it is quite similar to that we have on the screen now, and the Picture 1 on page 39. On page 39, we see two houses with an intact, new roof. This smaller house in front of the other bigger house, it's not to be seen on the video still we have on page 38. Can you explain that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, you are correct, sir. I've been in this place. I talked to the people who are living in this place, who used to live in this place before the war, and they confirmed that these two new houses were built -- or built after the war. This is why it's not visible on Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Both houses or one of them?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I think both of them. But I talked to the people who are living in these houses right now, and they said that they used to live there, but at least one of them, the bigger one and the red one from my picture, was not at that time there. I think another one also, but --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: To have a clear picture, I would like to see the video from that point in time when we have the videos at the same point in time as page 38, the Still A.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Certainly, Mr. President. We'll back that up and get to the next portion of Mr. Blaszczyk's testimony, which was going to be what's going on with these houses. So let's back up to about 16, say, 20, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, we have stopped at 16:33.3 in Sanction, which corresponds -- again, there's the four- to five-second difference with Video Still A, which is timed at 16:28.12 in the road book. We see, as His Honour has pointed out, two white-coloured houses in Video Still A, and you've identified the house that's a little further down the road away from the car as "the damaged house." If we look at Video Still B, what you referred to as "the damaged house" appears to be a little bit smaller than the house that's closer to the car that lies on the road earlier than the damaged house. If we look at your photograph from 2006 on page 39, we can see the damaged house that you've identified, and it appears to be tucked away a little bit in some of the trees, both in the Photograph 1 and then even more so in Photograph 2. I think we can see a big haystack piled right in front of the remains of that house. Can you tell us, Mr. Blaszczyk, was there any evidence, when you were there in 2006, of the larger white-coloured house that we see in Video Still A, and which is on our screen now in Sanction? Was there any evidence of that larger white house next to the damaged house?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's not evidence, in fact, because as I told Your Honour, that I talked to the people who were living there, and they confirmed that this house was over there before the war, and after the war -- after the war, it was destroyed and built new house, and you see in my picture this new red house --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- on the fundamental -- how you call in English? On the same place was built this new house.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: If you compare the two pictures, then, indeed, it is a different shape and we have a different location of the windows and the entrance and the balconies.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, this house, the first one on my picture and the second one on my picture, the red ones, they were built after the war.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And just to nail it down a little bit: So it's not the case, as in some of the photographs that we saw on pages 36 and 37, where you were able to see the same houses but with repairs. In this case, the house was completely torn down and a brand-new house was built on the foundations or the same location as the house that was there during the war. Is that what you're telling us?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're correct. You know, just comparing the previous houses from the previous page, we can see that they are the same houses, but just rebuilt or renovated. But in this case, if we are referring to the house on the page 38, the first one, the big one, it was erased, and on this place was built a new one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you for that clarification. Please carry on, Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: So you told us that Mr. Borovcanin has done a U-turn and they're heading back in the direction of the Sandici Meadow and Kravica. And I note, while we're here at 16:33.3 in Sanction, the unknown speaker on the Motorola radio in the first line is recorded as saying: "The column is moving." And then a caller identified as Oficir says: "Yes, yes, but to avoid any surprises." Again, just a quick question, because we will deal with this, I think, in the future: Can you give the Trial Chamber an idea of what this is referring to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As we know from various statements, that people who were kept at Sandici or captured near Sandici Meadow then were taken by column to Kravica warehouse. And also there is another column, column of the buses from -- buses containing women and children from Potocari who are passing this area -- who are passing close to this area towards Konjevic Polje, then Vlasenica and Kladanj.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And just one last question on this topic: During the course of your investigation, did the investigation reveal any witnesses who described the traffic along this road being stopped to prevent the columns of buses removing the civilian population from Potocari just prior to the Kravica warehouse executions?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we have such witnesses. They describe us that the traffic was stopped in Kravica -- before Kravica, in fact. Yes, we have such witnesses.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, let's turn to pages 40 and 41. We can save some time and not play video here.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Again, we're on the road heading back to Sandici and Kravica; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. Mr. Borovcanin, Pirocanac, and the driver, they are heading towards Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And what is this location depicted on pages 40 and 41?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This location is in Lolici area. This is a small village located about one kilometre from Sandici. And there are two walls. In fact, we are passing by now the first wall in Lolici area.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And how did you go about locating the stills on page 40 at your positions shown in the photo on page 41?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The same as I told before, I drove the same way what was driven by Mr. Borovcanin together with Pirocanac, and this is the only place when this footage could be taken following the sequences of Borovcanin -- of Petrovic video. And also looking at the shape of the road and looking at the surrounding hills, it's visible that this is the only place when this footage could be taken.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And it may sound like an obvious question, but what role, if any, did this retaining wall that we see here play in your ability to make this determination?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This retaining wall, you know, just keeping -- keeping the soil, you know, from just falling down to the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. But, again, my question is: There is retaining walls, I take it, all along these roads. How were you able to determine, if at all, that this is the retaining wall that we see in the Video Stills A and B on page 40?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe it's not very visible, the shape of this wall on the Petrovic video, because there are a lot of bushes over there, but if you look very carefully and you follow the road, how -- which was driven by Mr. Petrovic and Borovcanin, this is the only wall which could be depicted at that time by them.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Go ahead, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The next wall is just about 300 metres later on, on the left side, leading towards Sandici Meadow. And we could see this wall also on the video, on the Petrovic video, if we would play this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, indeed, the next section, I think, will require us to play about a minute of the video. And we're starting at 16 minutes 33.3 seconds in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We've stopped the video at 17:38.3. Let's just look at page 42 for a moment in the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We can see, in Still A, at 17 minutes 31 seconds, Mr. Lesic was able to capture a somewhat blurry image of a man, who appears to be in a camouflage uniform, as the car speeds by. I don't think -- it would be very difficult for anybody to have seen that in the footage we just saw, but can you confirm that Video Still A, in fact, precedes where we are now, which is 17:38.3 in Sanction?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. You know, just to catch this blurred man, you know, in uniform, we should play this video in slow motion, but it's quite difficult.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. I don't think we need to take up any time doing that right now. Can you tell us who the individual is who is recorded here in this frame that we have up on Sanction at 17:38.3?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Ljubisa Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's keep rolling the tape, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We've stopped at 17 minutes 57.6 seconds. Let's focus on the road book for just a couple of moments.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you explain what we're seeing in Video Stills B, C and D on page 42 and how you related that to your photograph on page 43?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The spot of this location was rather easy because it's quite significant or just a lot of details we can follow, and this place is located about 400 metres from Sandici Meadow. And I managed to -- on my photo from page 43, we see this location exact, the location. By arrows D, C, B, I marked the position of the man visible on the footage images from page 42, B, C and D. And as I said before, you know, just a man from the Picture A, from that Still Frame A we just passed was not visible on the video because we passed very quickly. And this is a small bend, you know, leading us to Sandici Meadow, and there is the barrier, and the men from the Frames B and C are just crouching behind the barrier, looking towards the woods, towards the hills.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay, and you referred to two retaining walls in your testimony a few moments ago. Can you tell us a little bit about the one we see on page 43?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is us -- I was referring to the second wall closer to Sandici Meadow. This is the wall just located after -- after the wall which -- on which barrier we saw two soldiers, you know, standing behind, standing over there. And this is a few hundred metres from the previous wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And you've noted an X and a circle on page 43, which is self-explanatory. Just for the Trial Chamber's information, have you, in the course of your investigation, connected these bodies that were exhumed at this location to any particular event?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can hear from one witness, I believe he's a protected witness, one member of the police, that -- who witnesses the execution of a few men in Sandici Meadow. I suspect -- I think it could be the bodies of the people who were found or put in this location. This location is about 400 metres from Sandici Meadow. It's -- the men who were executed in Sandici Meadow, they were executed towards the evening of the 13th of July, 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And with respect to the number of bodies that were found at this location marked as X, can you just give the Trial Chamber a rough idea of what we're talking about. Less than 20, more than a hundred? What are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, we're talking about a few bodies. We know that, it's confirmed that there were exhumed 17 bodies in 2004 by Bosnia Federal Commission. 17 bodies were found in this ditch behind this barrier.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And, again, just to remind us, the Trial Chamber has heard a lot of testimony and has seen evidence in this very video of many, many, many men, Muslim prisoners, being detained at the Sandici Meadow. Where did they end up going after being collected at the Sandici Meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Most of them were transported to Kravica warehouse, and we know what happened in Kravica warehouse. And the remaining prisoners, towards the evening, as we heard -- we interviewed a witness from the police, that he confirmed that the remaining prisoners were killed in Sandici Meadow. But most of the people, prisoners from Sandici Meadow, were moved to Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to pages 44 and 45. Again, we don't need to play the video, particularly because I think that it will be difficult to grab this frame using the equipment we have here in the courtroom, this Frame A on page 44.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Again, how were you able to locate Frame A in your photo on page 45?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said before, you know, just I compare features of the terrain over there, the shape of the road. I follow the movement of the camera and I located this place. I had noticed that this was this place where this man is depicted.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And how far away from the Sandici Meadow are we now on pages 44 and 45?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are very close to Sandici Meadow, about 250 metres from Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's just go back to the video. We're at 17:57.6. I think we can see that we've almost captured the Video Still A on page 46 of the road book here. The Trial Chamber, I think, has already seen this footage with Ms. Gallagher. We have a soldier here who is wearing fingerless gloves. We sometimes refer to him as "glove man." He's very familiar, we've seen him in footages that's being played over and over again. I think the Trial Chamber's already seen "glove man," the soldier with the gloves, being interviewed by Mr. Petrovic, and some Muslim men walking out of the woods along the top of a ridge, sort of walking in single file. So I think we can dispense with playing this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Again, can you tell us how you were able to locate these stills on Photographs 1 and 2 of page 47? And then I want to ask you a specific question about Photograph 2.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: My answer would be the same as before, you know. Just I compare the shape of the road, I compare the features of the terrain, the details of the terrain, and definitely, for sure, I'm 100 per cent sure that this is the place when the footages from page 46 were recorded, the same as I marked on page 47 of my panorama view and another picture, Picture 1 and Picture 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, I think that everybody has been able to see the road has twists and turns and various features. If we look at -- and we can see that from Photo 1 on page 47. If we look at Photo 2 on page 47, what you refer to as your panorama shot, this photograph seems to suggest that this road is a racetrack that goes in a circle. Can you explain what's going on in this photograph here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: My colleague, Zoran Lesic, used the equipment that were given us, let's say -- imagination that this road is going in this way, but, in fact, this road is a fairly straight road with two turns on the right and the left, a rather straight road.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So is it fair to say that the curvature that we see that begins in the middle of Photograph 2 and then extends to the right of the image is a side effect, as it were, of this attempt to get a full panoramic image?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. But having imagination how this road looks, it's better to look at -- exactly the shape of this road, it's better to look at Picture 1. This is exactly the road that -- we see this road, you know, just from -- from Point C, let's say, or from A/B towards -- towards the destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we turn to pages 48 and 49.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: After the discussion with "glove man," we see in the video the car stop -- or we see that the car has stopped and, for example, this soldier with the black headband, and then another soldier in a purplish T-shirt is scratching his forehead with his pistol in his right hand in Video Still C, where is this location, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is also on the road near Sandici Meadow. This is about 150 metres from Sandici Meadow and near the destroyed white house across the Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And the same question: Was there anything in particular about the features in this portion of the road that allowed you to make the determinations that are shown on Photographs 1 and 2, page 49?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The same answer. You know, when I followed the movement of the camera, when I recorded these events, just I noticed several details which I compare later on with the spot when I was there in 2006, and I noticed that -- I spotted this place in 2006, and I made a photo of this together with Zoran Lesic and made a photo of these particular places; the shape of the road, the barrier. Later on, we can see also the stream going down from the barrier.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to pages 50 and 51, then, for that.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you tell us what's going on in Stills A through C on page 50?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is also the place located where -- very near Sandici Meadow, on the road, and we see two members of Jahorina unit standing behind that barrier. And on the -- not visible very well here, but on Petrovic video, it's visible very well, on Still C we can see the stream behind the barrier. And I also made a picture of this stream on page 51 as picture number 3. And the barrier itself and this bend of the road is located very near the destroyed white house. This destroyed white house is especially visible on my picture, Picture 1 from page 51.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we would play Petrovic video, also this destroyed white house should be -- I believe, should be visible on this. A little bit. Not much, but a little bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now focusing on Video Still C from page 50 and Photograph 3 on 51, you said that there's a stream. So if we're looking at, for example, Photo 3, is that water that you can see through the brush?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is water.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Could you indicate the location of the stream on Photo 4, page 51?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I indicated -- no, no, I didn't, but I indicated the position of -- or let's say the location when the footage from Petrovic video was recorded, A, B, C, this is exactly in this location when I marked on Photo 4, an arrow, you know, just indicating the position of the footage of A, B, C. Below the barrier, there is the barrier. You know, if you zoom in this picture, it's visible that there is a barrier. Behind the barrier, there is a creek, a small stream.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: This is just a stab, Mr. Blaszczyk, but in Photo 4, if you look at the lower right-hand corner of the photo, if you look at the road and then look up a little bit from the road, there appears to be a sort of light blue or lighter colouration. Is that part of the stream or is that just something else that looks lighter? I'm just guessing, but I --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is part of the stream.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is part of the stream.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: But that's not exactly the same area in Photograph 3, I take it.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, no, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, this Photograph 3, we can look at -- if you look at the Picture 4, this Photograph 3 is taken on the place where I mark on Photograph 4 as A, B, C.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So that's up there at that location. All right. Let's go to pages 52 and 53. And Video Stills A and B, we see a man wearing a blue UN helmet. The Trial Chamber has already heard some testimony about this conversation between Mr. Borovcanin and the Serb soldier wearing the UN helmet. If we can just flip back to page 50, Video Still B. You can just see the first inkling of that soldier with the blue helmet there, and then we're up closer on page 52. The first question for you, sir: Can you identify whose car we can see in Video Still B, the lighter-colour car that we see more of, with the antenna on top?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is -- this is the car used by Mr. Borovcanin and Petrovic Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And how close are we now, on pages 52 and 53, to the Sandici Meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, we are next to Sandici Meadow on the road leading us towards Kravica, Bratunac, where it was to Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And just to move things along: I take it you employed the same technique to make your determination as to the locations you've indicated here; following the shape of the road and other features.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This place is quite easy to locate if we know this place, of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And you've, again, indicated the top of the destroyed white house which is visible from this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. And on the left side, I indicated also Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we turn the page to pages 54 and 55, let me just ask you: If we look at Photos 1 and 2 that you took on page 55, can you tell us what part of the house in these photos is visible back on page 53? When we see where you've identified the destroyed white house on page 53, what part of the house can you see, now that we're looking at it straight on on page 55?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's visible -- the attic of this house, remind me of the attic of this house from my picture from page 53.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: You said the attic of the house; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And that's that triangular shape that we see; is that what you're referring to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Exactly, triangular shape. There is no roof there, but this is the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. So is it -- just to kind of give us an idea of what's happened: Is it fair to say that we're now back to where we started this chapter, back in front of the destroyed white house in the Sandici Meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Exactly, we returned back to the beginning of this chapter at Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. President, I see we're coming up on the break, and this is as good a time as any for us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, are you able to indicate how much time you need in examination-in-chief on this topic?

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I have just a few more questions about this chapter, and then the remaining chapters are much faster. I think it will be another hour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We must have our first break now, and we will resume at 11.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Thayer, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. So we're at pages 54 and 55 of your road book, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: The men in Stills A through C on page 54, where are these men coming from and where are they headed?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: These men are coming out from the wood, from the hills behind the destroyed white house, and they're heading towards -- they were directed towards Sandici. They were located later on in Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. The Trial Chamber's already seen that footage of the soldiers directing these men across the street to the meadow. Looking at page 55, can you just tell the Trial Chamber what features you were able to isolate to make your determinations about the locations depicted there?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. On the page 55, we see three pictures of this white house from various perspectives. First, we see the Picture number 1, we see the white view from the Sandici Meadow. Picture 2 is also white house, the destroyed white house, seen from the road next to Sandici Meadow. And I made a picture of the destroyed white house from the west part of the destroyed white house, the back side of this white house and the western part of the white house. And if we watch the Petrovic video, we see that men are walking from the woods, from the hills, using the path behind the destroyed white house, going up to the front of the destroyed white house, were directed to Sandici Meadow, passing the road and getting to Sandici Meadow. If we look at the Petrovic video, you can easily recognise the pillars of this white house by the western part of the white house, and people are passing by the pillars of this destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: You describe -- sorry, please continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's not marked here on Picture 3 on from the page 55, but if we zoom in this picture, we could see also Kravica warehouse is visible from this location. This Kravica warehouse is located about -- exactly 900 metres from this location.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. I think we might lose the resolution on the e-court copy of the road book that we have.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: I can't remember off the top of my head, but does your interactive DVD or CD programme enable you to zoom on this photograph to see it?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It should be possible.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Now, you described a path on which these men were walking. Have you been on that path yourself, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I was there, I've been there quite many times.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And can you describe the topography of this white house? As we see on Photograph 3 of page 55, can you describe the lay of the land as it extends backwards away from the direction of the Sandici Meadow behind the destroyed white house?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As we see this destroyed white house is located above the road next to the Sandici Meadow, is located behind a small hill, and if we go behind this house, we go down, the path leading us down to the small valley over there, and then if you would walk up to the hills, you have to walk up, in fact.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And so you're saying that the path basically leads down into a valley. Is there any water or water source down at the bottom of that valley?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that there is -- there is the stream. This is the stream where I described before is going through this valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. If we look at Video Still C on page 54, there appears to be some kind of vehicle visible there. Can you tell us what that is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a bus. But if we play -- if we would play the Petrovic video, we could see it clearly that this is a bus standing on the road next to Sandici Meadow, between Sandici Meadow and destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And, in fact, if we play this video a little bit more, do we see more than one bus at this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, we see more -- more than one bus. We see also a few trucks over there.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And what were they used for?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The buses and trucks were used to transport the prisoners from Sandici Meadow to Kravica or to Bratunac, and also it could be -- I know that at one stage the buses with children and women, they stop at Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn the page to 56 and 57 in the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: You've again identified the footage from Video Stills A through F as occurring along this path that you've shown on page 57. Is that a fair summary?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, it's correct. This is the path I just have described a few minutes ago -- just a few seconds ago.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And if we look at Video Still A, we see some men in uniform, with weapons, walking in single file. What is this here that's depicted?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: These people, these men with uniforms, I believe most of them are -- were identified by us, by OTP. They were members -- mostly, they were members of the police, and they are just guarding or they are just taking the prisoners who stepped down from the woods, from the hills, and taking them to Sandici Meadow, directing them to Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And is this the path that you were referring to, sir?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, this is. And on -- I mentioned also the pillars of this white house, on the western part of this destroyed white house. The pillars are visible here on the page 56, on the Frame F.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now, this man that we see here in Video Still A, are you aware of the fate of this man in the blue shirt, whose name is Ramo Mustafic? The Trial Chamber will hear some testimony about that.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I know that the body of this man was found, but I don't remember where, exactly, from the top of my head.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, the Trial Chamber will hear some testimony pretty soon, I think, from Ms. Gallagher, when she talks about what we refer to as the Muslim ID book. Okay. I think we can keep moving. If we go to pages 58 and 59.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Again, can you tell us what's happening in the action here in Video Stills A through C? Where is this man who is wearing, it looks like, blue rubber boots in Still B coming from and where he is headed?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the Petrovic video, we know that this man is passing the destroyed white house by the Sandici Meadow and is directed by soldiers to go to Sandici Meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And you've located Video Still A on page 59 in Photograph 1?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct, and also in Photograph 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Yes. Were there any particular features that helped you make this determination?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the Photograph 1, you could see the poles of the fence. It's also very visible on the Frame A. And if we play video, itself, we could see also the pillars and the back side of the destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And if we go back to page 58 in your book, Video Still C, we can see what appears to be the back of a bus. Based on your review and knowledge of this tape, is this the same bus that we talked about a moment ago or was this a second bus that was in the area?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think this is the second bus. This is a second bus.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: But to be sure, I would prefer to play the video first.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And I think we will. We'll go back and play just a few seconds of the video so we can see this action. In this Still C, we see a small group of people who are huddled over something, and I think the Trial Chamber's already seen, and we'll see it in a moment, a group of people coming out of the woods, dragging an injured person. Do you recall, Mr. Blaszczyk, were the members of this particular group all male?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Most of them were male, but there is one female also.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Before we play this portion of the video: Over the recess, we located the slow-motion footage showing the tank that Honourable Judge Nyambe inquired about, and we'd like to play it. Unfortunately, on the court equipment it's not much of an improvement, even in slow motion, over what we saw before, but we've got it cued up. And if we want to keep looking at the Petrovic video, we need to close out of it, so with the Court's permission, we'll just play it now, for what it's worth. We might get lucky and you might be able to freeze it right on the right frame, but, frankly, with this equipment, it's very difficult. But we'll go ahead. And this is from P01008, which is the transcript, and the trial video itself is P00991. And we are at 2 hours 39 minutes 52.3 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: That's about as good as we can get in here with this equipment. So, unfortunately, we can't -- we've tried backing it up to see if we can catch some of those frames, but that's what we've got right now.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And let me just ask you, Mr. Blaszczyk: At this point in the footage, with respect to this tank, do you know or do you have a conclusion as to which direction the barrel of the tank is pointed?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't see here directly. It's difficult for me to adjust to tell, to be sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And you've viewed this video many times. If we look at this black object here, which you've identified as the tank, on the left of the screen, at the very top there appears to be something, and the top of that something is a little bit light coloured. Can you tell us what that is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to my analyst, it could be the machine-gun located on the top of the tank.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer, indeed, this picture is not very persuasive. Perhaps you can, at a later stage, find out a better picture, a better part of the video --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: -- where this object is more and better visible. We should leave this like it is at the moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Will do, Mr. President, and we'll continue with the Petrovic video. We'll just pick up the Petrovic video at 21 minutes 52.9 seconds on Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. We've stopped at 23 minutes 24.3 seconds. Ms. Gallagher has already testified about how Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac explained that this footage was underlying footage which somehow did not get recorded over when he was recording these events on the 13th of July.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Just prior to this, we saw a group of people emerging from that path. Were you able to identify whether one of those was a woman?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, we can identify that one person from this group is a female.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's just go back for a second and we'll take a look. If we could just go back a couple of frames, and tell us which one.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's the same female visible on my page -- I mean, my book page 58, Frame C.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We're at 23 minutes 19.4 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Which of the individuals in this frame, if any, is a woman?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The lady, this is the person from my left side, the last one from my left-hand side.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay, wearing a striped shirt or sweater of some kind; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Kind of sweater, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, how do you determine that this is a woman and not a man?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honour, if we play -- we can come back a little bit and we can see the face of this person, and we can hear also the voice of this person. It's visible that this is -- clearly visible that this is a woman, if we play -- if we play the video. It's difficult -- yeah, really, you are right, it's quite -- it's difficult to came to conclusion from this position that this is a woman, but if you play entire footage, we could see that this is a woman. We can hear also her voice.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: We should see this part of the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We're starting at 22 minutes 26.0 seconds in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you play a little bit more, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, you wanted to say something?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Could you play --

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We're going to get, I think, to the point that I asked you about before in just a couple of seconds. So we've stopped at 23 minutes 28.2 seconds. We'll continue playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 23 minutes 54.9 seconds.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And this portion, just one second before, I saw the face of this lady, and I saw the face of this lady on a better-quality picture than this monitor, of course. And before she climbed, together with other men, up there, we could hear her voice, and this is clear for me that this is female voice.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we can go back and --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: This is, indeed, your evidence, but it was hardly visible on this part of the video. But we saw this person again with this clothing. Judge Nyambe has a -- Judge Mindua has a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Witness Blaszczyk, we are talking about this person who is, in all likelihood, a woman. What I would like to know is this: Do you know how many women, in percentage terms, who were in the column, how many women there were? That's my first question, and then I'll have a second question.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's difficult to say exactly the percentage of the women in the column, but there were women. We have some footages even of the column, we see the women in the columns. How many, difficult to say, but there were -- there were women.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's -- oh.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Now my second question. As a rule, women and children and the elderly were transported on buses and trucks. Were we able -- or you able to discover how some women found themselves in some of these columns?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. We had some stories that some women didn't want to leave their brothers, their men, their husband, and they wanted to walk together with them to the woods to the free territory. And, Your Honour, if you -- if you look at -- I believe, at the testimony of Mr. Janc, there should be a report about exhumation of a few places, including the places related to Pilica Dom, where also the body of a woman was found over there. And we know, from a few witnesses, that woman was kept in Pilica Dom, for example.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MINDUA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Mr. Thayer.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Let's just go back and look at that small portion again, and you tell us -- you indicate to us when you hear the woman's voice. Just hold up your hand so that we know when you hear the woman's voice. Okay?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay, but we have to go back.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Now we're starting at 22 minutes 44 seconds in Sanction.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: We've stopped at 23 minutes 11.9 seconds.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is the part when I hear the voice of woman. I don't understand what he [sic] said, but for me this is clear, a woman voice.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Okay. And let's keep playing this one more time.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: And we've stopped at 23 minutes 17.7 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Again, Mr. Blaszczyk, you've held up your hand again. What did you hear?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we again -- I again hear the woman voice.

utterances.speaker: MR. THAYER
utterances.text: Can you describe anything distinctive about the voice, if we go back and listen to it on our own, later, that distinguishes it from any other voice that you've heard?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
